pages.title: A Season on a Wire
pages.text: Seasonal information can become part of home automation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use JEI for the sensor recipe. Wire a lamp to it and inspect its modes; the objective counts placement.

pages.title: Signal a selected season
pages.text: Right-click selects the sensor's season. It emits horizontal redstone while active, with strength based on season progress; placing it does not prove building a complex circuit.
